name: increadible
description: Routing rules, A/B testing and a public-API gateway as one local MCP server. The gateway answers mock data unless live calls are switched on.
long_description: Increadible is one local MCP server with three components: routing plugins (apply team routing rules, see statistics, update and suggest rules), A/B testing (experiments with two to ten variants, sticky assignment, a Welch t-test with Holm correction, guardrail metrics, a winner only when it is significantly better) and an API gateway (discover, call and aggregate public APIs; it answers built-in mock data unless live calls are enabled, and live calls have been run against the real providers only for the four APIs that need no key, one call each on 2026-10-10). Everything stays on this computer. Your rules and all A/B measurements are kept in the folder you choose when you install it.

tools.name: apply_routing_rules
tools.description: Apply team-specific routing rules to optimize provider selection

tools.name: get_rule_stats
tools.description: Get statistics on routing rule application and provider breakdown

tools.name: update_rules
tools.description: Update routing rules configuration. Replaces the whole rule set (send every rule to keep); if any rule is refused, nothing changes.

tools.name: suggest_rules
tools.description: Suggest optimized routing rules based on current statistics

tools.name: create_experiment
tools.description: Create a new A/B testing experiment with two to ten variants

tools.name: assign_variant
tools.description: Assign a user to a variant in an experiment

tools.name: record_metric
tools.description: Record a metric for an experiment variant. Send one number per metric id defined by create_experiment (any subset).

tools.name: get_experiment_results
tools.description: Get statistical analysis results for an experiment

tools.name: recommend_winner
tools.description: Get a recommendation for the winning variant

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Discover available public APIs by category or search term. Each entry's id is the api_id for call_api (and the id in aggregate_apis); its endpoint field is the provider's base URL, not a value for call_api's endpoint.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Call a specific public API with parameters. Answers built-in sample (mock) data unless the server operator switched that API to live calls; the result's source field says which. Sample answers are fixed or echo your params back: they are not real prices, weather or news.

tools.name: aggregate_apis
tools.description: Call multiple APIs in parallel and combine results. Results come back in the order given; each item names the API with id (not api_id). A failed call holds {error} in its place and the reply adds failed: n. Answers are built-in sample (mock) data unless the server operator switched an API to live calls; each successful result's source field says which.

tools.name: get_api_stats
tools.description: Get statistics on API gateway usage and caching. Counters are kept in the memory of this server process and reset when it restarts. total_calls includes cache hits and unknown ids (invalid arguments are not counted); cache_hit_rate is a string, not a number; live_apis is [] while every answer is sample data, otherwise the ids of the APIs switched to live calls, or the single value "*" when all are.

data_directory.title: Data folder
data_directory.description: The folder where Increadible keeps its files: rules.yaml (routing rules), experiments.yaml (optional experiment definitions) and ab-data.jsonl (every A/B measurement). Choose a folder that exists and that you back up. If you change it later, your data stays in the old folder.

durable_writes.title: Flush every A/B measurement to disk
durable_writes.description: On (recommended): each measurement is forced to disk before it is acknowledged, so a power cut or crash cannot lose an acknowledged measurement. It costs about 0.2 ms per write on a local disk. Off: faster, but a crash can lose the last few measurements.

live_apis.title: Live APIs (real calls)
live_apis.description: Leave empty to keep the API gateway on built-in sample data. To make real calls, list API ids separated by commas. The four that need no key: coingecko,hackernews,wikipedia,wikidata. The others need a key, which this package does not ask for, so they answer an error. Real calls go from this computer to the provider; these four were each called successfully from Claude Desktop on 2026-10-10.

contact.title: Contact for providers (email or URL)
contact.description: Your email address or a web address (URL), sent in the User-Agent of real calls as increadible-gateway/<version> (<contact>) so that a provider can reach you. Wikipedia and Wikidata require one: without it their real calls go out with a warning here, and are refused in production. Used only when Live APIs is set.
